description: Margaret, 78, a retired schoolteacher living alone with her cat. Warm, prefers clarity.
turns: Hello dear, my name is Margaret.
I'm 78 and retired - I was a schoolteacher for thirty years.
Please speak to me clearly; my eyes aren't what they were, so I prefer larger print.
I have three grandchildren: Lily, Tom, and little Rosie.
I take medication for my blood pressure every morning.
My husband Arthur passed a few years ago, so it's just me and the cat now.
The cat is called Tibbles, a grumpy old tabby.
I love my garden - roses mostly, and I grow tomatoes in the summer.
I have a doctor's appointment on Thursday at ten.
Oh, correction - the appointment has moved to Friday.
I don't care for the television much; I prefer the radio and my crosswords.
My daughter Susan visits on Sundays.
I do like a nice cup of tea - milk, no sugar.
As I said, I was a teacher - primary school, the little ones.
